short_description:
Can you replay missions in GTA 6? No: there is no mission replay and no chapter select at launch (Rockstar's design team said replays felt at odds with a story where your choices matter). What you get instead: 15 manual save slots. Save in a NEW slot before every big mission, so you can go back. Manual saves are blocked during missions, and guides disagree on how the autosave slot behaves, so keep a manual backup. No story spoilers.

Sources: Insider Gaming, PowerPyx, Engadget, Dexerto, GAMES.GG, Kotaku.
